section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics and Pearson correlation analyses for a single study with a total sample of N = 369 participants. Table 1 reports means, standard deviations, Cronbach's alpha reliability coefficients, and intercorrelation scores for five measures: BMI, Body Image Discrepancy (BID), Cognitive Fusion Questionnaire-Body Image (CFQ-BI), Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), and Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). Key findings include a significant negative correlation between BMI and body appreciation (r = -.27, p < .001), and strong negative associations between body image-related cognitive fusion and body appreciation (r = -.67, p < .001).
